About Frazier & Deeter

Frazier & Deeter (FD) is an award-winning accounting & advisory firm. FD and our family of brands serve clients worldwide, from the Fortune Global 500 companies to growing small businesses. Frazier & Deeter cultivates a growth mindset and instils in our people the belief that we must be adaptive and entrepreneurial, and we make a difference for our clients and each other. We focus on our brand promise of Investing in Relationships to Make a Difference.

FD offers a full range of tax, audit, accounting, and advisory services through our offices in Atlanta, Charlotte, Las Vegas, Nashville, Alpharetta, and Tampa, in addition to London and India. We have been recognized repeatedly as a Top 50 firm, a Best of the Best Accounting firm, a Best Firm to Work For and a Best Firm for Women in Leadership.

FD recently opened its own entity in India to support our expanding international and cross-border client base. We are not your typical firm of accountants and we like doing things differently. Our team members have the opportunity to be involved in global consulting and advisory client facing roles in a fast growing and exciting new business in India, which is part of our established and highly regarded accountancy firms in the US and UK.

About the Role

The AI Enablement Engineer is responsible for designing and scaling enterprise-grade AI solutions that enhance productivity and automate workflows across the firm. This role focuses on leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, and Anthropic Claude ecosystem (Claude, Claude Code, Agents, CoWork) to build agentic AI capabilities.

Responsibilities

Design and implement AI-driven solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Claude ecosystem tools
Build and deploy agentic workflows and intelligent agents
Develop integrations across enterprise systems using APIs and AI platforms
Leverage AI to process documents and automate decision workflows
Align solutions with Azure AI Foundry-based architecture
Build reusable AI components and scalable frameworks
Collaborate with global teams on AI initiatives
Work within CI/CD pipelines for testing and deployment
Document and improve solutions continuously.

Primary (Must-Have Skills)

Strong experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio
Hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry
Experience with Anthropic Claude ecosystem (Claude, Claude Code, Agents, CoWork)
Understanding of agentic AI patterns

Secondary (Good-to-Have Skills)

Experience with Power Automate
Proficiency in Python for automation
Experience with APIs and integrations

Additional Qualifications

Experience in AI enablement or automation initiatives
Exposure to compliance or audit workflows
Strong problem-solving mindset
Good communication and collaboration skills

What FD offers

Competitive salary
Clear career growth path within the firm
Personal and professional skills development and training support

#LI - remote
